title: Bear cub wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,14 38,42 62,42' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <polygon points='50,14 44,28 56,28' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <polygon points='44,28 38,42 50,42' fill='#06d6a0'/>
  <polygon points='56,28 50,42 62,42' fill='#118ab2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x='35' y='40' width='30' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <!-- Bear ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='10' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='10' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='5' fill='#d4915c'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='5' fill='#d4915c'/>
  <!-- Bear head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#d4915c'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='58' r='3.5' fill='#2b1d0e'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='3.5' fill='#2b1d0e'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='56.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='56.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2b1d0e'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M50 69 Q46 74 43 72' stroke='#2b1d0e' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 69 Q54 74 57 72' stroke='#2b1d0e' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Bear body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#d4915c'/>
  <!-- Paws -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='88' r='6' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='88' r='6' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='88' r='3' fill='#d4915c'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='88' r='3' fill='#d4915c'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='66' r='4' fill='#e8898f' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='66' r='4' fill='#e8898f' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
